payout_quote: If eligible, you can be compensated with Amazon.com electronic gift cards up to $127 for your time.
steps: Open the Project MAX page on the UW site
Confirm eligibility: young adults 21-29 in Washington state, not currently in college
Complete the 3-minute screening survey via the linked signup page
Complete the 5-minute phone call about the study
Complete the 20-minute baseline survey ($20 Amazon gift card)
Complete daily 3-minute surveys for 3 weeks (up to $52: $2/survey + $10 bonus for 80%+ completion)
Complete follow-up surveys at 1 month (~15 min, $25) and 3 months (~15 min, $30)
catches: Payout is 'up to $127' in Amazon.com e-gift cards, not cash — full amount requires all surveys and the 80%+ daily-survey bonus
Restricted to Washington residents aged 21-29 who are not currently in college
3-week daily commitment plus two follow-ups over 3 months
May be randomly selected to receive health information — no additional pay for that
biggest_catch: Full $127 requires completing everything including 21 daily surveys with an 80%+ completion bonus; eligibility is narrow (WA, 21-29, not in college).
eligibility: Ages 21-29, in Washington state, not currently in college; screening survey determines eligibility.
timing: Baseline $20 at start; daily-survey earnings over 3 weeks; follow-ups at 1 and 3 months. Gift-card delivery timing not stated.
